title: Greeting, Making Your Calling and Election Sure

questions.question: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have obtained a faith of equal standing with ours by the righteousness of our God and ____ Jesus Christ:
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:1 (ESV): "Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have obtained a faith of equal standing with ours by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:"

questions.question: May grace and peace be multiplied to you in the ____ of God and of Jesus our Lord.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:2 (ESV): "May grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord."

questions.question: His divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and ____, through the knowledge of him who called us to his own glory and excellence,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:3 (ESV): "His divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us to his own glory and excellence,"

questions.question: by which he has granted to us his precious and very great ____, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature...
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:4 (ESV): "by which he has granted to us his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world because of sinful desire."

questions.question: For this very reason, make every effort to supplement your faith with virtue, and virtue with ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:5 (ESV): "For this very reason, make every effort to supplement your faith with virtue, and virtue with knowledge,"

questions.question: and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with steadfastness, and steadfastness with ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:6 (ESV): "and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with steadfastness, and steadfastness with godliness,"

questions.question: and godliness with ____ affection, and ____ affection with love.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:7 (ESV): "and godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love."

questions.question: For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they keep you from being ineffective or ____ in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:8 (ESV): "For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: For whoever lacks these qualities is so nearsighted that he is blind, having forgotten that he was cleansed from his former ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:9 (ESV): "For whoever lacks these qualities is so nearsighted that he is blind, having forgotten that he was cleansed from his former sins."

questions.question: Therefore, brothers, be all the more diligent to confirm your calling and ____, for if you practice these qualities you will never fall.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:10 (ESV): "Therefore, brothers, be all the more diligent to confirm your calling and election, for if you practice these qualities you will never fall."

questions.question: For in this way there will be richly provided for you an entrance into the eternal ____ of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:11 (ESV): "For in this way there will be richly provided for you an entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Therefore I intend always to remind you of these qualities, though you know them and are established in the ____ that you have.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:12 (ESV): "Therefore I intend always to remind you of these qualities, though you know them and are established in the truth that you have."

questions.question: For we did not follow cleverly devised ____ when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:16 (ESV): "For we did not follow cleverly devised myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty."

questions.question: For when he received honor and glory from God the Father... we ourselves heard this very voice borne from ____, for we were with him on the holy mountain.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:17-18 (ESV): "For when he received honor and glory from God the Father, and the voice was borne to him by the Majestic Glory, 'This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased,' we ourselves heard this very voice borne from heaven, for we were with him on the holy mountain."

questions.question: knowing this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture comes from someone's own ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:20 (ESV): "knowing this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture comes from someone's own interpretation."

key_verse_text: For this very reason, make every effort to supplement your faith with virtue, and virtue with knowledge, and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with steadfastness, and steadfastness with godliness, and godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love.
